integrity: The statement is established by a constructive simultaneous conjugation, orbit-stabilizer and a graph-edge expansion. Exhaustive finite computation is supporting evidence only; no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Finite incidence algebras, finite fields, pairwise commuting tuples, and polynomial constraints with distinct roots in the base field. Does not cover noncommuting, nonsplit, or inseparable constraints; originality may overlap an unlocated more general semisimple-homomorphism theorem.
title: A Potts–Tutte formula for commuting split-separable tuples in finite incidence algebras
